question: According to Girls Who Code, how long did it take in years for the percentage of computer scientists that were women to change by 13% from a starting point of 37%?

history.content:

history.name: Assistant
history.content:
Answer: 20 years.
Rationale: Girls Who Code consistently cites the decline from 37% (1995) to 24% as happening "today" and, in leadership statements, describes this as occurring over "two decades." The earliest reliable instance of the "today it’s 24%" wording appears around 2015, which makes the duration approximately 20 years from the 1995 baseline.
